philippines.title: Super El Niño could cause 6,500 heat-related deaths in PH – study
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — An estimated 6,500 additional heat-related deaths could occur in the Philippines amid the “Super El Niño” from September 2026 to February 2027, researchers from the University of Chicago’s Climate Impact Lab said. The Philippines ranks ninth among the 50 countries projected to be most affected by heat from the Super El Niño, with Nigeria, Indonesia, Sudan, India and Brazil making up the top five, according to a figure in the report.
